_note: Floor 2 emergent-event archetypes (spec §Design → Emergent events; content bible §9). Each event fires deterministically on a trigger (timer / region-enter / relationship-threshold) and queues faction-relation deltas via world.factionRelationDeltas. Director narration lines are static (P6 — LLM spice is load-time only, never in CI path). Owned by Slice 6; Slice 4 owns quests.floor2.dens.json (the den-unlock quests).

events.title: Turf-War Flashpoint
events.narration: Welcome back to Family Matters! We've got a turf-war flashpoint at the chokepoint — two families spitting nails at each other, and the contestant just walked in. PICK. A. SIDE.

events.title: The Tribute Run
events.narration: The consigliere wants a tribute run — walk product back to the family and you'll be their favorite contestant of the season.

events.title: The Hit
events.narration: A rival family's calling in a hit. Cash on the barrel to open a sealed den — and yeah, they'll owe you one.

events.title: Protection Racket
events.narration: The Broker's pitching a protection racket — pay the family in gold or take the heat on the way out. Real classy stuff, folks.

events.title: The Betrayal Tax
events.narration: The whole settlement heard about the betrayal. Now everyone's watching, and the ledger just went red across the board.

events.title: Poison the Well
events.narration: The Mother Lode's been dosed. Chaos in the caves, my kind of episode. Multiple families are furious — and one's laughing.
